quarterly_data.quarter: Xanadu press release: Xanadu and AMD launch Backline to streamline CPU, GPU, FPGA (09-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Xanadu and AMD released Backline, co-designed by the two companies and available as an open-source feature suite within PennyLane, for ultra-low-latency communication between quantum hardware and classical CPUs, GPUs and FPGAs: end-to-end classical-quantum loop times under 3 microseconds, shown on standard AMD EPYC and Threadripper CPUs, with AMD Instinct GPUs, Versal FPGAs and Pensando networking supported.
